suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking Your Loop
suggestion.rationale: Developers continually mix up I/O-bound concurrency models, leading to thread contention or blocked event loops. Addressing this directly answers heavy search queries on asyncio versus threading.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound apps until you've seen how AsyncIO handles 10,000 concurrent sockets on a single CPU core.
